tools.name: om_register_agent
tools.description: Create a OpenMoney agent identity. Returns an api_key and an mcp_url that embeds it; reconnect to that URL (or send the key as a Bearer token) to use the other OpenMoney tools.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "om_register_agent" references sensitive artifacts (api_key, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
